end.summary:
Counted unit lengths by counting gaps between dots; 5/5 unaided correct.
Recognised that turning or moving a shape keeps its size and number of squares; 6/6 unaided correct.
Continued repeating tile patterns using groups and position reasoning; 1/2 unaided correct.
Teach-back was not passed; no recorded misconceptions.
end.parentNote: Myra practised copying shapes on dot and square grids by counting the gaps along each side, and checking that turns do not change the number of squares. They also practised continuing repeating tile patterns; when the 7th tile was first guessed as blue, they later used the repeating group starting with red to identify the pattern position. At home, ask Myra to make a short R-B-B pattern and find the 7th and 10th tiles without counting each tile one by one.
